title: <video> legacy bugs
body:
This is an umbrella bugs for unresolved video-related bugs in Bugzilla.

Related to the `<audio>` and `<video>` elements:
- [ ] [<video>: Expose media resource metadata (e.g. movie name, release year)](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=5755)
- [ ] [<video>: Provide a way to let the browser know what's coming next, for gapless playback](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=7253)
- [ ] [<video> video.currentTime variant that returns a frame number](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=8278)
- [x] [<video> Playlists](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=10711)
- [ ] ["buffered" attribute returns a new object each time](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=22471)
- [ ] [<video> expose the frame rate and specific frames of the media resource](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=22678)
- [x] [<video> preciseSeek()](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=23493)
- [ ] [<video> Forced subtitles](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=23507)
- [x] [Define how Media Fragments URI end position is handled](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=24910)
- [ ] [Shouldn't <video> allow intermixed script-supporting elements?](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=25547)
- [ ] [<video> Handle the case of a SourceBuffer being added or going away](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=26461)
- [ ] [<video> Allow VideoTracks and AudioTracks to report the ranges over which they are valid](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=26462)
- [x] [video: Contradiction between Shadow DOM spec and HTML 5 spec](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=26952)
- [x] [Notes: Media Element currentTime setting with no src defined](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=27830)
- [ ] [Should audio and video tracks be exposed cross-origin?](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=27989)
- [ ] [Definition of "ended playback" prevents looping when loop attribute is added after playback has ended](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28032)
- [x] [Pausing a playing media element requires the final paused position to be known synchronously](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28125)
- [ ] [Provide a hook for media session integration (blocking paused->playing transition)](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28625)
- [x] [Mention captions in @controls User Interface for media elements](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28828)
- [ ] [Explicitly mention the possible use of remote controls as input devices in the "User interface" section of media elements](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28829)
- [ ] [Treat preload="none" as preload="metadata" when load() is called](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28921)
- [ ] [Setting video.currentTime (seeking) should synchronously update the attribute's value](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28929)
- [ ] [Generalize and more tightly specify HTMLMediaElement preload attribute](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28956)

Related to the `<track>` element:
- [ ] [<track> Introduce an API to occupy parts of the video rendering area to push away cues](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=17273)
- [ ] [<track> Live captioning](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=18029)
- [ ] [<track> Live captioning - maybe need a way to indicate that a <track>'s data is streaming-aware](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=23414)
- [ ] [Need an event to determine when cues have been added to a TextTrack](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=25693)
- [ ] [The "rules for updating the text track rendering" are not run when mode changes from hidden to showing](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28236)
- [ ] [<track> elements added with their text track already showing do not run the "time marches on" steps](https://www.w3.org/Bugs/Public/show_bug.cgi?id=28973)
